description: Maps each dataset to its supplying provider(s). References ONLY Provider Registry IDs and Dataset Registry IDs. Does not duplicate provider metadata.

mappings.notes: Indian Railways is the authoritative source for railway zone definitions.
Indian Railways is the authoritative source for railway division definitions.
Indian Railways is the authoritative source for official station codes.
Indian Railways is the authoritative source for the station master list.
Government open data portal may publish supplementary station data.
OpenStreetMap is used for cross-reference verification of station data only.
Indian Railways is the authoritative source for the train master list.
Indian Railways defines the station category classification system.
Indian Railways is the authoritative source for station operational status.

notes: Provider-dataset mapping registry. Each entry associates a dataset_id with a provider_id and a role (primary, supplementary, or verification). No URLs, API endpoints, resource IDs, or download logic are included.
